sonnet.problem: Card 1 already calls Esau 'Jacob's twin brother', and card 5 sets up the move. The blank 'far away from his ___' is then answered by an earlier card, so 'brother' is no discovery. Father and uncle are ruled out by what the baker has already been told.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Card 3 says Esau took his wives 'from the daughters of Canaan'. That puts the answer word (Canaan) in front of the baker and makes the wrong answers (Paddan-aram, Egypt) look unlikely before the question is asked.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
